value.rationale: A complete stationary and first-passage classification for a natural symmetric counter-zealot extension quantifies the critical trade-off in nonlinear opinion aggregation. It separates full-support flat fluctuations from sharp boundary concentration and central Gaussian coexistence, with an exact critical mean clock m(m+1)H_m versus exponential noncritical mean clocks. These are motivated, size-parametric structural results rather than arbitrary finite examples or minor numerical improvements.
